answer: Before filing, the filer must put the finished work up at the oasis auction under the nebula lantern, where real buyers bid on it. The Opal desk reads the auction book within a day: the work must fetch at least 50 coins from a buyer who is not the filer, or the claim is rejected and the 250-coin bond is forfeited, so 1,000 fakes need 1,000 real buyers plus 250,000 coins. One operator filed forty claims and bid on all forty himself, and all forty fell when the book showed one bidder for forty works.
